title: Fleet steering message (brain <-> sister <-> subagents)
description: The message contract for the session fleet operating model (M26, issue #160). The brain is the only sender of directives to the sister; the sister only spawns epic-focused subagents per a directive; subagents report results back through the sister. Everything else is refused.

id.description: Unique message id (uuid4). Stamped by the channel when absent.

from.description: Sender role. brain is the only directive issuer.

type.description: directive = brain order; ack/result = sister/subagent reports; halt = stop signal.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; stamped by the channel when absent.

correlation_id.description: Binds a result/ack to the directive that caused it.

model.description: FinOps block: the model tier and thinking effort the target must run at. Overrides outside the allowlist are refused.

budget_hint.description: Optional cost hint for the subagent's run.

task.description: Work to execute: an issue (and optionally the epic it serves).
